<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head></head><body>
<img id="img" src="logo.avif">
<canvas id="cvs" width="244" height="244"></canvas>
<script>
window.onload = function() {
    var img = document.getElementById('img');
    var cvs = document.getElementById('cvs');
    cvs.width = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
    cvs.height = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
    var ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    var data = cvs.toDataURL('image/png');
    var p = document.createElement('p');
    p.id = "done";
    p.innerText = img.naturalWidth + 'x' + img.naturalHeight + ':::' + data;
    document.body.appendChild(p);
};
</script>


<p id="done">244x244:::data:image/png;base64,</p></body></html>
